blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — For the first time in decades, young people in Isabela staged a major protest on Monday, Nov. 16, opposing the Pax Silica initiative and the scheduled visit of US President Donald Trump to the Philippines for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. From outside the Our Lady of the Pillar Parish in Cauayan City, nearly 150 young protesters marched toward Rizal Park to denounce the initiative, which some fear could have far-reaching consequences for Indigenous peoples, the environment, and the country’s natural resources. “Although Tarlac is far from Isabela, the causes Filipinos fight for are […]...
